founders.title: Founder/CEO
founders.founder_bio:
Terrell Marshall is the co-founder and CEO of Lore.

Before Lore, Terrell worked on AI products with over 1 billion users at Google, like Google Photos, Google Payments, and Hotels Search, and as a software engineer at Workday. Before that, Terrell studied computer science where he met his co-founder Aditya Nadkarni and created a patent for an AI Physical Therapy Platform

founders.title: Founder/CTO
founders.founder_bio: Aditya Nadkarni is the co-founder and CTO of Lore. Together with his co-founder, Terrell Marshall, they help users transform their iMessage conversations into shareable stories. Aditya spearheads the development of their platform, drawing from his experience at Flexport's AI and document processing team, and Artera, a start-up streamlining doctor-patient communication.

launches.title: 🧭 Passage - Clearing goods just got easier
launches.tagline: AI co-pilot for clearing goods through customs.
launches.body:
**tldr:** [Passage](https://www.trypassage.com/) is an AI co-pilot that helps businesses clear their imported goods through customs.

# **🙏 Our Ask**

* **Do you (or someone you know) work in logistics?** Whether you import goods, move goods (e.g., freight forwarders), or clear goods (e.g., customs brokerages), let us buy you a coffee and book some time with us [here!](https://calendar.app.google/krfxBvRqXMP416eW8)
* Just want to give Passage a spin? Try it [here](https://assistant.trypassage.com?u=launchyc) for a limited time!

# **⛔️ The Problem**

* Every company that brings goods into the US (e.g., Apple, IKEA) needs to clear it through customs
* The problem is that clearing customs is super complicated. It has tons of manual work, and if a business screws it up, they face thousands in penalties
* This leads to businesses spending hundreds of thousands on customs services, only to spend hours on manual data entry and searching complex regulations

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=82216&key=user_uploads/1316171/28651bd0-d381-4593-960c-6126aa32cc69)

# **⚙️ The Solution**

* To tackle this, we’ve built a co-pilot to make clearing customs easier than ever for businesses
* Have teams of people manually keying in data? We’ll help streamline the tedious data entry from shipping documents, so your team can spend time on the things that matter
* Worried about submitting incorrect data to the government? We’ll check that the data is consistent across all your shipping documents and proactively flag if there’s anything that doesn’t line up

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=82216&key=user_uploads/1316171/594ed69f-d766-485a-8692-588eabc34e32)

* Struggle to understand complex regulations or classify products? We plug directly into key government resources like the code of federal regulations and product tariff schedule so you can clear your goods without the fear of huge penalties

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=82216&key=user_uploads/1316171/a5bb48d5-bac6-4161-a9a2-020d07676b17)

# **🧑‍🤝‍🧑 The Team**

[Aditya](https://linkedin.com/in/aditya-nadkarni) and I ([Terrell](https://linkedin.com/in/terrellm)) are friends from college and even have a patent for an AI physical therapy platform. Since college, we’ve moved in together as roommates in San Francisco and have worked on AI products at Flexport and Google. Aditya helped build the AI document processing platform at Flexport (which is how we first learned of the many issues in the logistics industry), and Terrell shipped AI editing features used by Google Photos’ +1B user base.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=82216&key=user_uploads/1316171/3ff82873-ae62-4972-b81e-63cc25fa6fd8)

Above is a photo of us after skydiving :) 🪂
